# ChangingDecimal

    Examples

    Example: ChangingDecimalExample

    [Video example](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/ChangingDecimalExample-1.mp4)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class ChangingDecimalExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            number = DecimalNumber(0)
            self.add(number)
            self.play(
                ChangingDecimal(
                    number,
                    lambda a: 5 * a,
                    run_time=3
                )
            )
            self.wait()
    ```
